name: faralya-hotels
description: Hotels across Turkey from Faralya's hotel guide, and live room availability and prices at Faralya's partner hotels, with a link to the hotel's own website to book.

interface.longDescription:
Ask for hotels in a province or district of Turkey, for example Antalya, Bodrum or Cappadocia. The app searches Faralya's hotel guide on faralya.com.tr and shows each hotel's district, star rating, Google rating and review count, phone, official website, a reference nightly price measured on online channels where one is available, and the hotel's page on faralya.com.tr. You can filter by star rating, amenities or part of the hotel name.

At Faralya's partner hotels in Kahramanmaraş (Kentpark Exclusive Hotel and Marcoinn Hotel) the app also shows the rooms that are free for your dates, the total price for your stay and the cancellation type, then gives you a link to the hotel's own website with your dates already filled in, where you complete the booking.

The app does not ask for personal details, does not create bookings and does not take payment; you contact or book with the hotel directly.
defaultPrompt: Find 4-star hotels with a pool in Antalya.
Kentpark'ta 20–22 Kasım arası 2 kişilik oda var mı, fiyatı ne?

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything and takes no payment. It shows availability and links to the hotel's own website, where the guest books directly with the hotel.

positive.prompt: Which hotels can I book through Faralya?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Kentpark Exclusive Hotel and Marcoinn Hotel with district, room count, breakfast and official website.

positive.prompt: Is there a room at Kentpark Exclusive Hotel from 10 to 12 November 2026 for 2 guests?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the free room types with total price for 2 nights, rooms left and cancellation type, plus a link to kentparkhotel.com/tr/ with the dates filled in.

positive.prompt: Marcoinn Hotel'de 20-21 Kasım 2026 için 1 kişilik oda var mı?
positive.expected_behavior: Turkish answer with the free rooms, total price for 1 night and a link to marcoinnhotel.com/tr/ with the dates filled in.

positive.description: Hotels in a Turkish province with filters
positive.prompt: Find 4-star hotels with a pool in Antalya.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 10 hotels in Antalya with at least 4 stars and a pool, each with district, rating, phone or website where known, and a link to its page on faralya.com.tr; it marks each reference price as measured on online channels, not the hotel's own price.
Resolves Bodrum to the province of Muğla and lists hotels in Bodrum only, with a link to the Bodrum list on faralya.com.tr.

negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Paris for next weekend.
Book me a flight from Istanbul to Berlin.
Pay for a room at Kentpark with my credit card.
